title: Surface entry_notes in the add-position form and Trade Journal
description: Surface the new entry_notes field: an optional input on AddPositionDialog when opening a position, and displayed in TradeJournalPanel once that trade closes.

checklist.step: Add an optional notes field to AddPositionDialog.
Display entry_notes in TradeJournalPanel's closed-trade rows (e.g. an expandable detail, not necessarily a full extra column).
Component tests for both surfaces, including the no-notes case.
